column1: # Divergences for Amiga packer wrappers (PowerPacker); see README.md.

column4: RECOIL has no PowerPacker support and rejects the packed file. Unpacked with Ancient 2.x (BSD-2, black box): our depacker output is byte-identical to it, and recoil2png on that unpacked FORM ANIM decodes to the same pixels as ours (pixel-identical, first frame).

RECOIL has no PowerPacker support and rejects the packed file. Unpacked with Ancient 2.x (BSD-2, black box): our depacker output is byte-identical to it. recoil2png on that unpacked HAM8 ILBM gives 1280x1024 where every row is doubled: even rows and odd rows each equal our 1280x512 exactly, so the decode is the same and only the line doubling differs (RECOIL doubles super-hires interlaced CAMG 0x29824; the ILBM aspect scaling does not know super-hires, a separate pre-existing gap). Output reviewed: heart, trash can and cyan lettering on a purple floor.
